01K4AT70CGWREAH0QX3851QAJ3.body: Our database experienced an increased write load which brought several services off line.  We identified the problem and implemented a fix to resolve the immediate outage and prevent this class of incident from happening again in the future.
01K4AT70CGWREAH0QX3851QAJ3.title: Services are unresponsive

01K97TQX9HZ1E5759E2R2FSMGA.body: We recently made changes to our GitOps process to further improve how we deliver software. As part of that change, we introduced a small bug that broke name resolution between our core service and our content service. This resulted in content changes not showing on our public pages.  We implemented and deployed a fix and have confirmed all content persistence and caching is functioning correctly.
